scope: Non-Hong-Kong-ID customers opening or converting to HSBC One on or after 2026-01-01.
chargeDay: Fourth working day of subsequent months, until the preceding three-month average TRB qualifies for the waiver.
trbIncludes: local and overseas securities market value
otherExemptions: Opened or converted using a Hong Kong ID
calculationScope: The holding-period control counts complete billing months. Remaining initial assessment months can be 0–3 and default to 0; the calculator does not assume an existing user is a new customer, treat a partial opening month as a full month, or infer historical TRB from the current principal. Full-period qualification is independent of the introductory phase. This is not an exact bank debit calendar.
